definitions.explanation: The outer surface or appearance of a building, vehicle, or object.
The outermost layer of packaging for a product, as opposed to the inner packaging.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外装|がいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}える→塗り替える：06270_nurikaeru⟧。
examples.english: To repaint the exterior of a building.

examples.japanese: {外装|がいそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧。
examples.english: The exterior looks nice, but the inside is quite old.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外装|がいそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついてしまった。
{外装|がいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{外装|がいそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{破損|はそん}→破損：13679_hason⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: To check the outer packaging for damage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{外装|がいそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡素|かんそ}→簡素：09202_kanso⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦しっかりしている→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧。
examples.english: The product's outer packaging is simple, but the contents are solid.

notes:
{外装|がいそう} has two main uses: the exterior of buildings/vehicles and the outer packaging of products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (buildings):
- {外装|がいそう}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: exterior renovation work
- {外装|がいそう}⟦{塗装|とそう}→塗装：06582_tosou⟧: exterior painting
- {外装|がいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}える→塗り替える：06270_nurikaeru⟧: to repaint the exterior

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (packaging):
- {外装|がいそう}{箱|ばこ}: outer box
- {外装|がいそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{破損|はそん}→破損：13679_hason⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: the outer packaging is damaged

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{内装|ないそう}→内装：06425_naisou⟧: interior (the direct opposite)
- ⟦{外観|がいかん}→外観：12154_gaikan⟧: outward appearance (overall visual impression, while {外装|がいそう} emphasizes physical materials and finish)
